locator.section: Chapter 4 Basic Mechanisms of Ion Fragmentation; radical-site (alpha) cleavage of amines

evidence.curator_note: ARC COUNT / DRAWN-vs-INFERRED (convention D): Figure 4.4 is the diethylamine BAR SPECTRUM annotated with wavy cleavage-marks (which bond breaks -> which m/z) and the '58a' peak label; it draws 0 curved electron-pushing arrows. The 3-fishhook alpha-cleavage flow encoded here is curator-inferred from the book's own alpha attribution (the cleavage-mark + 'a' label), not transcribed from drawn arcs. Second alpha channel of the same diethylamine molecular ion (m/z 73, M+.): loss of a hydrogen atom from the alpha carbon gives the iminium ion CH3-CH=N(+)(H)-CH2CH3 at m/z 72 (M-1). Book draws 0 curved arrows for this step: it is shown by a horizontal squiggly bond-cleavage mark drawn across the alpha C-H bond of the explicitly drawn CH2 group, bracketed and labelled '72' (McLafferty's cleavage notation, not electron-pushing arrows). All 3 electron moves are encoded here for electron balance (odd electron on N into the forming N=C pi bond; one electron of the breaking Ca-H sigma into that pi bond; the second electron of that sigma onto the departing H atom); NONE is drawn as an arc on the page. The alpha carbon's departing hydrogen is given explicit atom map :6 so the homolysis is balanced; it carries an explicit protium isotope tag [1H] (mass 1.008, chemically ordinary hydrogen) purely as a tooling device so RDKit retains it as a mapped atom instead of folding it into an implicit H count -- it is NOT an isotopic label of the real molecule.

No MØD rule in src/data_generation/rules/ encodes this amine alpha C-H (M-1, loss of H•) cleavage. The nearest amine alpha-cleavage rule IMS_4_43_ (book eq 4.43) handles only the Ca-Cb channel (loss of an alkyl radical, the m/z 58 scheme of record IMS4-FIG4.4a). A search of rule_index.json for a nitrogen alpha-cleavage rule that expels an [H.] fragment while forming N=C returned no match, so this M-1 channel is currently unmodelled by MØD.

The figure marks the alpha C-H cleavage of diethylamine with the bracketed label '72' (M-1). Figure 4.4 is a bar spectrum with no printed numeric intensities; the m/z 72 bar is minor and no percentage is printed, so relative_intensity is omitted and the status is 'inferred'. observed_mz is the curator-computed monoisotopic mass of the proposed C4H10N+ iminium ion, not a value read from the page.
